plugin.name: Law Firm Management
plugin.description: Case intake & approval, regulatory-grade conflict-of-interest checks with collaborative clearance, billing & invoice ledger (manual reconciliation and Kingdee/Yonyou integration), and lawyer workload & executive dashboard.
expense.formHint: Court fees, expert fees, travel and similar costs are not legal fees. The client pays them separately, so they are kept apart from the legal fees under Invoicing & Fee Collection. Under China's Measures for the Administration of Lawyers' Service Fees, settlement must include a list of costs paid on the client's behalf with valid vouchers; the client may refuse any part without a valid voucher. This ledger is stored on this device.

billing.title: Hourly billing: from time review to the bill
billing.intro: Lawyers build time from their work log, or add it manually, under Settings › Work log › Billable time and submit it. The lead lawyer or a partner reviews it here each month and issues bills. Once the client confirms, the bill amount becomes an invoice application under Invoicing & Fees, where invoicing and collections are handled as usual. Rates are tax-inclusive; amounts round to the cent. This ledger is stored on this computer.
billing.seeded: Sample loaded: an hourly matter for the fictional client Xinghe Tech, {n} submitted entries from last month by four lawyers of different levels, a rate card, and a 10% discount with a fee cap.
billing.reviewHint: Grouped by client and matter. Write-downs, description edits, no-charge and returns are all kept in the review trail, and lawyers see the outcome and reason in their work log.
billing.noMatterHint: These entries belong to projects not yet registered under Intake, so they cannot be billed. Register the matter and link the project, then approve.

billing.termsHint: Per the engagement letter: agreed rates by level override the firm standard rate (blank uses the standard rate); the discount is a percentage; the cap is the cumulative limit across all bills for the matter.
billing.metrics: Billable hours and realization by lawyer
billing.metricsHint: Counts entries by work date in the selected month. Realization = collected ÷ value at standard rates, counting only entries with an outcome: on a client-confirmed bill, or marked no charge at review. Collected is the payments reconciled against that bill's invoice under Invoicing & Fees, split across lawyers in proportion to their line amounts.

cloud.title: Firm cloud features
cloud.intro: These features store some data on the AI WorkDeck collaboration service (or your firm's own team server) so the firm's lawyers can work together across computers. Each is off by default and is turned on per firm by a firm administrator. Turning one off stops new data, and you can choose to delete what is already stored for it. Fee amounts, invoices and collections always stay in the local ledger and are never uploaded.

cloud.feature.clients.name: Clients and parties
cloud.feature.clients.desc: When on, the firm's lawyers can share client records, contacts and related parties through the firm cloud for colleagues to use in intake and conflict checks.
cloud.feature.time.name: Time collection
cloud.feature.time.desc: When on, lawyers can submit billable time (date, duration, work description, matter, billable or not) to the firm cloud. The partner who published the matter retrieves it for review and billing, and the review outcome returns to the lawyer's work log. Work descriptions may involve client information, so include only what is necessary.
cloud.feature.pitch.name: Pitch and experience entries
cloud.feature.pitch.desc: When on, lawyers can share their experience entries with their team or the whole firm for use in tenders and client proposals.

cloud.feature.other.desc: See the privacy note for what this feature stores.
